description_en: Create a DNS authorization rule for an instance group
name: AddGroupDnsAuthorizationRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en: Name, which can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Description of the authorization rule. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则描述，长度不超过256字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The DNS server address to which traffic is redirected
parameters.help_zh: 需要重定向的DNS服务器地址
parameters.name: destination_ip

parameters.help_en:
A unique token used to ensure idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The value must contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without creating the instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are exceeded. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and creates the instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并删除实例
parameters.name: dry_run

AuthorizationRuleId.description_en: The ID of the generated DNS authorization rule
